# §5 Commerce Analytics — Highlight Candidates

1. **eCat order volume grew 3× in 12 months** — from 185 orders in April 2025 to 600–725 per month by early 2026, with eCat Online expanding from 125 to 660 monthly orders and now accounting for 87% of total volume. [→ §commerce]
2. **iPad orders carry a 68% AOV premium over eCat Online** — $3,117 vs. $1,857 in the trailing 12 months, contributing 19.5% of GMV on just 12.6% of orders and validating the value of rep-guided selling alongside self-service. [→ §commerce]
3. **Revenue concentration is healthy at 16.9% across top 5 buyers** — well below the 25% alert threshold, with 435 active accounts distributing $12.4M in eCat GMV across a broad base. [→ §commerce]

## Priority Action Candidate
- **OPPORTUNITY**: Increase quote workflow adoption — only 10 of 6,147 orders (0.2%) used the quote path in the trailing 12 months, despite quotes carrying the highest AOV ($3,400); promoting quotes for larger or more complex transactions could lift per-order value [HYPOTHETICAL]. [→ §commerce]
